agent.version_title: v16 + BUNDLE v1.2 (2026-10-29): grouped asks, break-out to discovery, consent in the name+number turn, facts, team opener rule

post_call_analysis_data.description: Copy the flow's own trip type, never re-derive it from the conversation: the flow recorded '{{trip_type}}' (arrival = arrival, departure = departure, p2p = point_to_point, hourly = hourly).
post_call_analysis_data.name: trip_type

post_call_analysis_data.description: Copy the flow's value '{{is_charter}}': true only when it is true (the caller described a charter, bus, coach, motorcoach, wait-and-return, as-directed trip or a group event).
post_call_analysis_data.name: is_charter

post_call_analysis_data.description: The trip date as an absolute calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD), resolved against the date this call took place, from what the caller said ('{{pickup_date}}'). Never use a stale or training-data year. Leave empty if no date was given.
post_call_analysis_data.name: pickup_date

post_call_analysis_data.description: The pickup time as captured ('{{pickup_time}}'), e.g. '7 PM'. Leave empty if none was given.
post_call_analysis_data.name: pickup_time

post_call_analysis_data.description: The full pickup as captured, venue, street and city, copied word for word from '{{pickup_location}}'. Leave empty if none was given.
post_call_analysis_data.name: pickup_address

post_call_analysis_data.description: The full drop-off as captured, venue, street and city, copied word for word from '{{dropoff_location}}'. Leave empty if none was given.
post_call_analysis_data.name: dropoff_address

post_call_analysis_data.description: The airport for an airport trip ('{{airport}}'). Leave empty otherwise.
post_call_analysis_data.name: airport

post_call_analysis_data.description: Airline and flight number for an airport trip ('{{airline_flight}}'). Leave empty otherwise.
post_call_analysis_data.name: airline_flight

post_call_analysis_data.description: For an airport arrival, copy '{{meet_style}}': curbside, inside (at baggage claim with a sign) or not_stated.
post_call_analysis_data.name: meet_style

post_call_analysis_data.description: The name for the meet-and-greet sign, if given ('{{sign_name}}'). Leave empty otherwise.
post_call_analysis_data.name: sign_text

post_call_analysis_data.description: Number of passengers as captured ('{{passenger_count}}').
post_call_analysis_data.name: passenger_count

post_call_analysis_data.description: Number of bags ONLY if the caller stated it ('{{bag_count}}'). Leave EMPTY if the caller never gave a bag count. Never write 0 unless the caller said zero or no bags.
post_call_analysis_data.name: bag_count

post_call_analysis_data.description: For a charter or hourly trip, the number of hours if the caller gave it ('{{hours}}'). Leave empty otherwise.
post_call_analysis_data.name: hours

post_call_analysis_data.description: Copy the flow's value '{{one_way}}': true only when the caller said one way or just the transfer.
post_call_analysis_data.name: one_way

post_call_analysis_data.description: Copy the flow's vehicle label exactly ('{{vehicle_class_label}}'). Leave empty if it is blank.
post_call_analysis_data.name: vehicle_class

post_call_analysis_data.description: The caller's own name as given on the call (the reservation contact on a demo trip, or the person the team should ask for).
post_call_analysis_data.name: caller_name

post_call_analysis_data.description: The mobile number given for the reservation contact, or the number the caller agreed the trip sheet should go to.
post_call_analysis_data.name: caller_mobile

post_call_analysis_data.description: Whether the caller agreed to receive a text: the trip sheet, or the setup-call confirmation. The flow's own record is '{{sms_consent}}'. False when the caller said no to texts or said not to text them.
post_call_analysis_data.name: sms_consent

post_call_analysis_data.description: The name of the caller's company or organization, written the way the caller confirmed or spelled it (the flow has '{{company}}'). Leave empty if none was given.
post_call_analysis_data.name: company_name

post_call_analysis_data.description: True only if a follow-up call with the team was booked during this call (the calendar tool returned BOOKED).
post_call_analysis_data.name: appointment_booked

post_call_analysis_data.description: The caller's level of interest in setting up AI Chauffeur for their company, in a few words.
post_call_analysis_data.name: interest_level

post_call_analysis_data.description: The caller's verbatim answer describing what they thought of the demo, if they gave one.
post_call_analysis_data.name: demo_feedback

post_call_analysis_data.description: Anything the caller asked dispatch or the driver to know ('{{notes}}'), in a few words.
post_call_analysis_data.name: special_notes

post_call_analysis_data.description: Copy the flow's value '{{review_needed}}': true when the group is over 56 passengers, needs a wheelchair lift or an oversized item.
post_call_analysis_data.name: review_needed

post_call_analysis_data.description: Which part of the call the caller used: demo = they only did the demo trip (played the customer and requested a trip); questions = they only asked about AI Chauffeur, asked for the team, or were not there for the demo; both = they did some of each.
post_call_analysis_data.name: door

post_call_analysis_data.description: The number the team can reach the caller on: a number the caller said on the call (the latest one if they corrected it), otherwise the number the flow has on file ('{{caller_phone}}'). Digits with country code. Leave empty if there is none.
post_call_analysis_data.name: caller_cell

post_call_analysis_data.description: Who the caller is: operator = runs or works at a transportation or logistics company (limo, black car, charter, shuttle, trucking, courier) or says they would use this for their company; agency = a marketing agency, reseller or consultant who wants this for clients; passenger = someone who wants a real ride or has a problem with a booked trip; vendor = selling a product or service to us, or a recorded sales message; unknown = not clear.
post_call_analysis_data.name: caller_role

post_call_analysis_data.description: A short list of the questions the caller asked about AI Chauffeur, in a few words each, separated by semicolons. Leave empty if they asked none.
post_call_analysis_data.name: questions_asked

post_call_analysis_data.description: True if the caller asked what AI Chauffeur costs (not the fare for a trip). False otherwise.
post_call_analysis_data.name: price_asked

post_call_analysis_data.description: True only if a setup call was booked on this call: the calendar tool returned BOOKED (the flow has '{{appointment_booked}}'). A calendar failure, a timeout or a callback is not a booking.
post_call_analysis_data.name: setup_call_booked

post_call_analysis_data.description: True if the caller asked for, or accepted, a callback from the team. False otherwise.
post_call_analysis_data.name: callback_requested

post_call_analysis_data.description: Result of the live connection to the team. The flow recorded: '{{transfer_state}}'. connected = the transfer tool succeeded and the call ended bridged to the team; declined = a transfer was tried and the transcript shows the team turned the call down; no_answer = a transfer was tried and did not connect for any other reason (no answer, voicemail, timeout); not_attempted = no transfer was tried.
post_call_analysis_data.name: transfer_result

post_call_analysis_data.description: How the caller said they heard about AI Chauffeur, in their own words (the flow has '{{heard_about_us}}'). Leave empty if they were not asked or did not answer.
post_call_analysis_data.name: heard_about_us

post_call_analysis_data.description: The single best description of how the call ended, taking the first that applies in this order: spam = a vendor or sales call, a recorded or automated message, or dead air (the caller never said anything); wrong_line = a passenger who wanted a real ride or had a problem with a booked trip; connected = the caller was bridged live to the team; setup_call_booked = a setup call was booked (calendar tool returned BOOKED); callback = the team is to call the caller back; demo_taken = the agent read the whole trip back on this call (a sentence ending "Anything need changing?" was spoken); info_only = everything else, including a caller who got answers and declined the rest, or who left before the trip was read back.
post_call_analysis_data.name: outcome

post_call_analysis_data.description: True if the caller said not to text them (the flow has '{{no_text}}'). False otherwise.
post_call_analysis_data.name: no_text

post_call_analysis_data.description: True if any of these: the caller never said anything at all (dead air); the caller was a recorded or automated message; the caller confirmed they were selling a product or service. False for every real caller, including a caller who was only asked whether they were selling.
post_call_analysis_data.name: spam
